title: The SMART+ Framework for AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct empirical measurements but proposes the SMART+ Framework to evaluate this bias. The framework assesses racial and ethnic disparities (e.g., underdiagnosis in darker skin tones) through cross-group error analysis, sensitivity analysis, scenario-based evaluations, and fairness metrics like equalized odds and demographic parity.

Addressed conceptually as a sensitive attribute within the SMART+ Framework, proposing evaluation through cross-group error analysis, sensitivity testing, and the application of statistical fairness metrics (e.g., predictive parity, demographic parity) during the AI lifecycle.
